comparison.objective: Replace a server CR2032 cell in a sprung, hooked socket.
comparison.physical_skill: Millimetre-scale latch release, coin-cell extraction, tilted insertion, and snap seating.
comparison.success_condition: New cell seated positive-side up under the hook and latch, with loose or dropped cells permanently failing; exact tiers are absent.
comparison.reason: This is precision spring-latch replacement, not a screw/jam-nut calibration task.
